# `search.users`

Search users

Trigram FTS over the public user directory in name order. Only active users appear; the continuation rides the body.

- Method and path: `GET /search/users`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie search users`
- MCP: `search_users`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
